generation.scope: The generic recovery degree from one projected configuration is exactly two. The two finite-edge AS windows are the original orientation and its reversal; one ordered first edge determines the extension. At both rational samples the same classification holds. A pencil of quartics with twenty triple points recovers every normalized square root, including the exclusion of degenerate Grassmann candidates.

proof_review.scope: Reviewed nonvanishing for deficient square maps, polar-rank criterion, projective gcd specialization including infinity, determinant uniqueness, properness of the Grassmann fiber, and two-window uniqueness.

mathematical_computation.scope: 2-dimensional kernels in four 1100 by 715 polar systems; compressed seven-minors have gcd degree two with no common root at infinity. At the rank-ten even root the gcd is a square. Reversed cubic overlap checked at rank sixteen.

open_mathematics: Use the pair of determinant quartics to study the double cover and its ramification at the odd-symmetric divisor; determine the intrinsic intersection scheme of the two Veronese images. Seek an effective closed-fiber AS criterion and quartic centers on the full component.
